fieldValues.title: Discovery
fieldValues.description: A portable contract for asking a repository what it holds, split deliberately into two halves that behave differently. Structured filters, over type, container, tag, tier and lifecycle state, are exact-match predicates: two conforming implementations with the same data must return the same set. Free-text content matching is a recall floor: every instance whose projected text contains the normalised query must be returned, and returning more, or ranking differently, is explicitly permitted. This is what lets a naive substring matcher and a semantic search engine both conform.
fieldValues.notes: Matching runs over a deterministic text projection: an ordered sequence of segments derived from an instance by a stated rule about which fields are searchable, normalised at match time by Unicode NFC and case folding, with punctuation, diacritics and whitespace left intact.
